flavor: A bloated, grey-skinned 僵尸 sits atop a pile of rusted iron scrap. Its head is unnaturally thick, polished to a dull sheen like a heavy anvil. It stares at the party with milky eyes, offering a heavy, jagged coin in exchange for a moment of your vitality.
name: The Iron-Skulled Revenant
reason: The party encounters a sentient undead entity that trades essence for ancient currency.
